Subject: Trial kickoff: quick recap & activation checklist

Jordan / Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track progress: 

1) Objective: Validate Redwood inference in your staging environment to measure latency, cost per 1k tokens, and integration effort for your search-relevancy microservice.
2) Success metrics (agreed): <10% change in QPS latency at 99th pctl; embedding similarity >= current baseline; proof of concept demo with sample queries by Feb 12.
3) Action items (owners & deadlines):
   - Acme: provide staging endpoint and basic sample corpus (Samantha) — target: 2026-02-03
   - Acme: open network port range + IP allowlist (Jordan) — target: 2026-02-04
   - Redwood: provide POC activation checklist & onboarding support (Marissa/Neha) — target: 2026-02-02

I've attached the POC activation checklist and our minimal network requirements to this thread (redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf). If the dates above look tight, propose alternatives and we'll adapt.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Feb 5 to confirm environment readiness, but if you need help earlier, ping me and we'll get an engineer on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Hey Jordan — appreciate the update. Attached is a short security handoff note we've shared with SOC/compliance teams in similar POCs (summary + answers to common questions). I added a few bullets specific to data handling in a staging scenario.

If Friday (Feb 6) is the earliest your network team can open the allowlist, that's fine — we can shift the sync to Monday Feb 8 at 10am PST. I'll hold that time and send a calendar invite; Neha will join to support the initial config.

Options I can offer for a quick unblock: 
- 30-min pairing session with Neha (engineer) to walk through allowlist/IP config and initial token tests
- A lightweight sandbox we can spin up on our side so you only need to point a test agent at it (no network changes on your infra) — useful if your networking window is delayed
- If procurement needs a purchase order or a sample PO to move the network/infra tasks, I can surface our standard PO template.

If this is no longer a priority, tell me and I'll close the POC ticket on our side. If it's still on the roadmap, what's the best time for a pairing call? I'm available Wed Feb 11 9–11am PST and Thu Feb 12 1–4pm PST.
